seo.title: Landscaping in View Royal, BC: Stratas & Irrigation | RNC
seo.description: Strata grounds care, irrigation checks and repairs, planting and tree work for View Royal homes on Portage Inlet and near Thetis Lake. Get a free quote.

cardSummary: Portage Inlet waterfront, sloped family lots and townhouse stratas, with shore pine and nest trees protected by bylaw.
intro: View Royal sits between the Gorge waterway and Thetis Lake: waterfront homes on Portage Inlet, family streets in Helmcken and Atkins, townhouse stratas, and hospital and institutional grounds.

View Royal’s Tree Protection Bylaw (No. 1069, 2022) protects species including shore pine, trees with raptor, osprey or heron nests, and Town trees. Most removals or alterations need a permit; small-branch pruning is exempt only when an ISA certified arborist does it. See [irrigation](/services/irrigation/) or [get a free quote](/free-quote/?area=view-royal).
localRulesIntro: View Royal’s bylaw names shore pine and nest trees, exempts small-branch pruning only when an ISA certified arborist does it, and sets a short deadline for emergency removals: notice with photos by the next business day.

localNotes.title: View Royal Tree Protection Bylaw
localNotes.text: View Royal's Tree Protection Bylaw No. 1069 (2022) protects species including shore pine, replacement trees, trees with raptor, osprey or heron nests, trees kept as a permit condition and Town trees. Removing or altering protected trees generally needs a Tree Removal or Alteration Permit; pruning branches up to 10 cm by an ISA certified arborist is exempt, and emergency removals need notice with photos by the next business day.

localNotes.title: CRD lawn-watering schedule
localNotes.text: CRD Stage 1 watering rules run May 1 to September 30 for properties on the regional water supply: lawns may be watered on Wednesdays and Saturdays (even addresses) or Thursdays and Sundays (odd addresses), 4-10 am or 7-10 pm; hand watering and drip irrigation of trees, shrubs and gardens is allowed any day. Multi-unit complexes use the complex's street address. New sod or seed does not need a permit and has a temporary schedule.

localNotes.title: Invasive plants and disposal
localNotes.text: The CRD Regional Invasive Species Program lists priority species (including giant hogweed, knotweed, gorse, poison hemlock, shiny geranium and yellow toadflax) and asks for sightings to be reported. Invasive plants must be disposed of properly: Hartland Landfill takes them bagged and labelled or in covered loads, and knotweed needs a controlled waste permit and is not accepted at municipal yard-waste drop-offs.

conditions.title: Portage Inlet shoreline
conditions.body: Waterfront lots drain straight to the inlet. Keeping fertiliser, clippings and soil out of the water, and leaving a planted buffer at the edge, protects the shoreline.

conditions.title: Slopes and drainage
conditions.body: Many lots slope toward the inlet or the Craigflower valley. Runoff, soggy low spots and erosion often need solving before new planting or turf.

conditions.title: Dry rocky ground near Thetis Lake
conditions.body: Lots near the Thetis Lake area can be rocky and dry in summer, with arbutus and shore pine that suit low-water planting around them.

topServices.why: Older strata and home systems on sloped lots tend to need zone-by-zone checks, repairs and better coverage.
Townhouse stratas and family homes want reliable recurring care, with the shoreline kept clean.

servicesBlurb.grounds-maintenance: Recurring care for townhouse stratas and family homes.
servicesBlurb.landscape-installation: Planting near the inlet and on sloped lots, with drainage in mind.
servicesBlurb.irrigation: Zone checks, repairs and maps for strata and home systems.
servicesBlurb.tree-vegetation: Tree work planned around View Royal's protected species and nest trees.

jobNotes.title: Unmown strip along the inlet
jobNotes.body: A lawn edge along Portage Inlet was left as an unmown native strip, and clippings were bagged rather than blown toward the water.

jobNotes.title: Shore pine checked before pruning
jobNotes.body: Limbs over a deck were left in place until the shore pine was assessed against the Town’s bylaw and the permit question was answered.

cta.body: Tell us if the property is waterfront or sloped, and for stratas, roughly how old the irrigation is. Both change how we plan the visit.
